title: Turbo Jumbo configuration
description: Configuration for the Turbo Jumbo model manager (config.yaml).

peers.description: Machines that share models, including this one. The local peer is the one whose address host matches this machine's IP.

peer_check_interval.description: How often, in seconds, to poll each remote peer for reachability and model changes. Optional; defaults to 5.

address.description: host:port the peer serves on. For IPv6, bracket the host, e.g. "[2001:db8::1]:3000".

slug.description: URL-safe id for this peer, used in its tab path (/zurich) and in /api/v1/peers/<slug>/…. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Optional; defaults to the name lowercased with runs of other characters turned into hyphens. Set it when that default would be empty (a name with no ASCII letters or digits) or would collide with another peer.

base_path.description: Directory containing the model subdirectories. Required for the local peer.

cold_storage_path.description: Cold-storage (archival) model directory. Required for the local peer.

turbo_jumbo_subdir.description: Subdirectory name under base_path for local models. Optional; defaults to "turbo-jumbo".

lemonade_subdir.description: Subdirectory name under base_path for Lemonade's model cache. Optional; defaults to "lemonade".

lemonade_url.description: API base URL of the Lemonade server associated with this peer (e.g. "http://192.0.2.10:13305/api/v1"), used to browse and download the models only that server can fetch (FLM/NPU). Optional.
